sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers "awhile" and "briefly" mean nearly the same thing, so they are look-alikes of each other.
sonnet.rule: Two wrong answers never mean the same as each other either.

sonnet.problem: Cards 9, 11 and 16 in this stop (and card 10 in stop 2) all use the same joke: the LORD's power or lasting purposes set against Papa Dorin's small kitchen limits. That is the same punchline shape repeated within one lesson.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
